items.q: What documents do I need to book a chauffeur service?
items.a: To book a chauffeur service with AB.Limo, we typically require a valid government-issued photo ID and your booking details. Additional information may be requested for airport transfers or special arrangements.

items.q: Is there a minimum age requirement for passengers?
items.a: There is no minimum age requirement for passengers travelling with our chauffeur service. For bookings involving minors, additional arrangements may be needed in advance.

items.q: Do I need to pay in advance for my booking?
items.a: Depending on the journey type and location, a booking confirmation, card authorisation, or advance payment may be required to secure your reservation.

items.q: Are airport pickups included in the service?
items.a: Yes, our airport transfer service includes flight monitoring, punctual meet-and-greet support, and assistance with luggage whenever required.

items.q: Can I change or cancel my reservation?
items.a: Yes, changes and cancellations are possible subject to our booking terms and the timing of your request. We recommend notifying us as early as possible.

items.q: How long does a city-to-city transfer take?
items.a: The duration depends on the distance between cities. For example, Dubai to Abu Dhabi takes approximately 1.5 hours, while Riyadh to Dammam takes around 4 hours. Your chauffeur will choose the most efficient route.

items.q: Can I make stops during my city-to-city journey?
items.a: Yes, you can request additional stops during your journey. Simply let us know your requirements when booking, or communicate with your chauffeur during the trip. Additional stops may incur extra charges.

items.q: What vehicles are available for long distance travel?
items.a: We offer Business Class sedans, First Class luxury sedans, and Business Van/SUV options for city-to-city travel. All vehicles are equipped with Wi-Fi, charging ports, and refreshments for your comfort.

items.q: Is there a maximum distance for city-to-city transfers?
items.a: We cover distances up to 500 km for a single booking. For longer distances, we can arrange multi-day transfers with overnight stops at premium hotels along the route.

items.q: Can I book a round trip?
items.a: Yes, round-trip bookings are available. You can schedule your return journey at the time of booking or arrange it later through our app or customer service.

items.q: What is the cancellation policy?
items.a: Free cancellation is available up to 24 hours before your scheduled pickup. Cancellations within 24 hours may incur a fee. Please check our terms for full details.

items.q: Do you provide child seats?
items.a: Yes, child seats are available upon request. Please mention your requirements when booking so we can ensure the appropriate seat is installed in your vehicle.

items.q: Are your prices fixed or metered?
items.a: All our city-to-city transfers have fixed prices. You'll see the exact fare when you book, with no hidden charges or surge pricing.

meta.title: Sustainability - AB.Limo | Driving a Greener Future
meta.description: AB.Limo is committed to sustainability through electric vehicles, carbon offsetting, and net-zero initiatives.

hero.desc: Our commitment to the planet goes beyond compliance. We're actively shaping a sustainable future for luxury ground transportation.

ev.p1: Electric vehicles are no longer the future — they're the present. At AB.Limo, we're accelerating our transition to a fully electric fleet, ensuring every ride contributes to cleaner air and quieter cities.
ev.p2: From Tesla Model S and Mercedes EQS to BMW iX, our growing EV fleet delivers the same luxury experience with zero tailpipe emissions. We're investing heavily in charging infrastructure to ensure seamless coverage across all our operating markets.

carbonOffset.p1: Every ride taken with AB.Limo is fully carbon offset. We invest in verified carbon reduction projects — from reforestation in the Amazon to renewable energy installations in Sub-Saharan Africa.

faq.q: How does booking and pricing work?
a: 1. Enter your pickup and drop-off locations to see a fixed price.
2. Choose your preferred service class and vehicle.
3. Select your pickup date and time.
4. Confirm your booking and receive instant confirmation.
5. Your chauffeur details will be sent to you before your ride.

faq.q: What happens if my flight is delayed?
a: We monitor all flights in real-time. If your flight is delayed, your chauffeur will automatically adjust the pickup time. You won't be charged extra for flight delays, and your chauffeur will be waiting when you land.

faq.q: Is meet and greet service included?
a: Yes, meet and greet service is included with all airport transfers. Your chauffeur will meet you in the arrivals hall with a personalized name board and assist you with your luggage.

faq.q: Can I cancel or modify my booking?
a: Yes, you can cancel or modify your booking up to 24 hours before your scheduled pickup time at no extra charge. For changes within 24 hours, please contact our support team.
